analogy.rationale: Aromatase (CYP19A1) is a cytochrome P450 enzyme that is expressed at low levels in most of these cell lines, so aromatase inhibitors should elicit little transcriptional response; other CYP inhibitors and endocrine-targeting classes may show weak overlapping effects, while sterol-synthesis and androgen-receptor classes share only distal steroid-pathway or hormonal context.
